name: Gokuaku Yuusha Kichiku Tabi -Ali*han yori Tabidatsu!?-
original_name: 極悪勇者鬼畜旅 アリ○ハンより旅立つ!?
source:
Demon King releases a dangerous man after a year sentence. He takes what he wants and any women he wants and either sells them to slavery or gives to monsters for raping. A real villain comes to the scene, and even Demon King is not an authority for him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
魔王在服刑一年后释放了一名危险人物。他拿走他想要的东西和任何他想要的女人，然后将她们卖为奴隶或交给怪物强奸。真正的反派登场，连魔王都不是他的权威。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
